# stb_truetype, vendored

The settings panel's text (`src/ui/t2_text.c`) is drawn with
[stb_truetype](https://github.com/nothings/stb) by Sean Barrett, public
domain or MIT as the user chooses (`LICENSE`). `stb_truetype.h` is v1.26,
from upstream commit `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`, copied
unchanged from the GGX+ port.
